pd.about.about_legal: sent when the user opens a licence document in About; the boot shows the version only

pd.channels.secret.channels_set_secret: sent by Save once a secret is typed; the boot does not type one (channel-secret-dialog.spec drives Save against the memory backend)

pd.mcp.key.mcp_issue_key: sent by Create key once a client is named; the boot names none (mcp-dialogs.spec drives it)

pd.report-problem.diagnostics_save: sent by Save report…, which asks the OS where to save; the boot never saves
pd.report-problem.diagnostics_cancel: sent by Stop saving during a save; the boot never saves
pd.report-problem.log_from_webview: sent only when the window logs a warning or error; a clean boot logs none
